_comment: What an innkeeper lets slip over an ale. Authored, never generated: host/npcd.py draws one at random for the ALE request. 'stages' limits a hint to those quest stages (see STAGES in host/npcd.py); 'inns' to those inn ids from assets/towns.txt. Each line must fit the C64's reply box (150 characters, plain ASCII) and must be true -- and since the land is made fresh each game, give no directions.

hints.text: The king's rider asked after you by name. Castle Matheson is on this side of the sea, a long walk. Do not keep a king waiting.
The road to the castle is long and the beasts are many. Mistress Coyle will sell you draughts for it.
The Hollow Crown is the deep place on this side of the sea. That Sigil of yours is what opens it.
Vane will want more than a stone for his key. The fishers have a word for when the Drowned Stair runs dry. Ask one of them.
Old Brann has fished this water forty years. Ask him about the tide, and listen to how he says it.
The Drowned Stair is in another country over the water. The captains will carry you now. Mind the tide.
The Drowned Stair is in another country over the water. Wardlow folk know it better than we do.
Mother Ash in Ashcombe keeps the Ashen Key. Take her what you brought up out of the Stair.
Blackpit is in a country over the water, deep in forest, thick with things that bite. Carry draughts.
Three stones, and Garrett the smith has the only anvil fit to use them. He is in Millford.
Maldrath lairs in the mountains of Keldmarch, in a burnt hollow. Go well rested.
Everyone is drinking to you tonight. You are still paying for your own, mind.
The princess keeps her door locked, but there's a secret passage into her tower for those who care to look for it.
Some beasts carry a treasure map. It tells you how far from a town to walk, and you dig with L on the spot. Press I to read them.
A dug-up map pays better the further along you are. A man who never fights never finds one, mind.
A ship waits at a port on each coast of Keldmarch, and every ship sails for a different country. The captains answer to the king.
The captains will not sail for a stranger. Not until the first stone is found, and then one country opens with each stone.
Each country over the water has a town of its own, with an inn and a shop. Worth a visit before the deep places.
Maldrath is banished. The hollow in the mountains is cold for the first time in three winters.
The deeper a place goes, the more the chests hold, and the worse thing keeps the stairs.
Keep to open grass where you can. Forest and swamp are where the beasts are thickest.
Drink a draught before a fight, not only in one. Mistress Coyle in Millford sells them.
Bowyers sell bows, and the castle has one. Shoot a beast before it reaches you and it has less to hit you with.
The castle sells blades, mail and bows. All of it is cheaper than a burial.
Whoever falls out there gets carried home to Millford, and wakes with half their purse gone.
The keepers of the deep places will not let you run. Go down ready, or do not go down.
Old Tam will tell you about the second army if you let him. He is the part of it that came back.
Salt, fish and books, that is Wardlow. Vane's library is the last one in Keldmarch, and he will tell you so.
